criteria.requirement: Add IntervalDict.transform_values(function, *, pass_interval=False) returning the same concrete class without mutating the source. Call once per stored (possibly composite) interval/value entry in order, optionally passing (value, interval). Only identity with IntervalDict.DROP deletes an entry; None and unhashable values are legitimate. Rebuild through existing normalization so equal outputs merge correctly. Preserve domain except dropped entries, propagate callback exceptions and retain custom IntervalDict subclasses.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
